text:
Type: low white storage unit frame
Use: base for a TV bench, sideboard or wall cabinet once fitted with doors, drawers or shelves; living room, home office, dining room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated particleboard, pre-drilled holes for shelves and hinges, small grey feet
Colors: white, grey feet
Shape: wide open rectangular box carcass with flat sides, top and bottom, rows of holes along the inner sides, empty front, low and boxy, medium visual weight
Feel: clean, plain, modular, practical
Goes with: white or wood-effect fronts, glass doors, light floors; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: BEST
product.description: You can choose to stand the frame on the floor or mount it on the wall to free up floor space.
